主要从事数字集成电路设计领域的研究，研究方向包括2.5D/3D集成芯片、SoC体系结构、高性能异构计算与神经网络加速电路等。承担国家重大专项、国家重点研发等多个重大项目中的芯片课题，在28nm和40nm等工艺下成功流片Logic-on-SRAM三维集成计算芯片、2.5D芯粒接口与集成芯片、粗细混合粒度计算芯片、系列RISC-V SoC人工智能芯片。近年来，在集成电路领域重要期刊会议上发表SCI/EI论文30余篇，授权国家发明专利10多项。

Associate Professor of Shanghai Jiaotong University
IEEE Senior Member, Former Chairman of the Singapore Chapter of IEEE Youth Alliance
Research Direction: Low-power integrated circuit design, Electronic design automation
Address: Room 427, Microelectronics Building, 800 Dongchuan Road, Minhang District, Shanghai
Email: Yongfu.li[AT]sjtu.edu.cn
Homepage: https://www.yongfu-li.com/
Personal Profile
Yongfu Li，he received the B.Eng. and Ph.D. degrees from the Department of Electrical and Computing Engineering, National University of Singapore (NUS), Singapore. He is currently an Associate Professor with the Department of Micro and Nano Electronics Engineering and MoE Key Lab of Artificial Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, China. He was a research engineer with NUS, from 2013 to 2014. He was a senior engineer (2014-2016), principal engineer (2016-2018) and member of technical staff (2018-2019) with GLOBALFOUNDRIES, as a Design-for-Manufacturability (DFM) Computer-Aided Design (CAD) research and development engineer. His research interests include analog/mixed signal circuits, data converters, power converters, biomedical signal processing with deep learning technique and DFM circuit automation. Dr. Li received the Singapore Economic Development Board GLOBALFOUNDRIES Graduate Scholarship. He is actively contributing to the Singapore Section Young Professionals Affinity Group and has served as the Secretary (2012–2013) and the Chair (2014–2015).

教育背景
2008-08~2012-07 西安电子科技大学 学士
2012-08~2019-10 澳门大学 博士
2016-08~2017-08 乌尔姆大学（德国）访问交流
工作经历
2019年博士毕业后在华为海思无线射频部工作，从事模拟集成电路设计。于2020年8月，加入上海交通大学，历任长聘教轨助理教授、长聘教轨副教授、长聘副教授，目前担任教授。
研究方向
1. 高性能模数转换器设计（包括奈奎斯特和过采样）；
2. 围绕精密传感/工业测量应用的低压/高压信号链电路设计，包括AFE，带隙基准，温度传感器等；
3. 围绕高速无线/有线通信的模拟电路设计。
科研项目
现/曾主持的科研项目
国家重点研发计划“战略性科技创新合作”重点专项, "应用于毫米波通信的高能效模数转换器芯片关键技术研究"，2022-2025；
“脑科学与类脑研究”国家科技重大专项课题，“低噪声高密度高输入阻抗脑电图机研发”，2026-2030；
国家自然科学基金面上项目，"基于外插预测的时域交织连续时间ΔΣ调制器关键技术研究", 2025-2028;
国家自然科学基金青年项目，"基于多级噪声整形架构的宽带连续时间ΔΣ调制器研究", 2022-2024;
华为公司产学研合作项目（一期），“宽带高信噪比连续时间模数转换器技术研发”，2022-2024；
华为公司产学研合作项目（二期），“高速与高精度模数转换器关键技术”，2026-2027；
歌尔股份有限公司产学研合作项目，“硅基OLED驱动IC关键模块开发项目”，2023-2024；
上海市“科技创新行动计划”国际科技合作项目，2025-2028。

1. IEEE Trans. CAS-I 期刊 （Q1区， IF=5.2）编委 （2026~）
2. 国内高起点期刊《集成电路与系统》（英文）编委（2025~）
3. 中文核心期刊《微电子学》青年编委（2025~）
4. IEEE Trans. CAS-II 期刊编委（2022~2026）
5. IEEE ESSERC (欧洲固态电路协会旗舰会议) TPC (2026~)

个人简介
代表论著
上海交通大学教授、国家级人才、上海交通大学微纳电子学系系主任/国家示范性微电子学院执行院长。加州大学圣克鲁斯分校博士学位。
主要从事超低功耗的数模混合集成电路设计及生物医疗电子研究。曾就职于美国Second Sight Medical Products及Agere Systems和中国华为公司。现（曾）主持国家、省部级、企业创新研究项目9项，包括国家自然科学基金、973项目子课题、863项目子课题、国家归国留学人员基金、上海市科委科技攻关项目、企业科技创新项目等多项科研项目，累计项目经费超过1500万元。
发表国际同行评阅期刊及会议论文近百篇，其中SCI期刊论文20余篇，所发表的论文被引用次数1462次（Google Scholar），近三年被引用次数年均增长约130次，H指数为15。获得多个奖项，包括国际论文奖1次，国内论文奖1次，上海交大优异学士论文(全校前1%)指导教师奖5次，其它交大教学类奖项4次，集成电路竞赛指导教师奖5次，交大年度考核优秀2次，并于2018年荣获上海交大“教书育人三等奖”。
目前是IEEE的高级会员(Senior Member)，并担任IEEE 电路与系统学会（CASS）副主席、生物医疗电路与系统领域的国际顶级期刊IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Circuits and Systems (TBioCAS,影响因子4.3) 的主编（Editor-in-Chief）。

3373.name: 吴子涵
3373.officialText:
吴子涵
助理教授
长聘教轨助理教授
所在系所：芯片设计与EDA研究所
电子邮件：zihanwu@sjtu.edu.cn
教育背景
2019年获得华中科技大学本科学位，2021年获得复旦大学硕士学位，2026年获得北京大学博士学位。
工作经历
2026年加入上海交通大学集成电路学院，现任长聘教轨助理教授，主要从事高能效芯片与智能计算系统研究。累计发表高水平学术论文约20篇，包括ISSCC 3篇、JSSC 5篇、CICC 2篇，相关成果还发表于IEEE TCAS-I、TCAS-II等旗舰期刊与会议。同时长期担任IEEE JSSC、TVLSI及ISCAS等期刊和会议审稿人。
研究方向
长期从事面向智能计算与复杂优化的高能效芯片架构及设计方法研究。研究主要包括以下三个方向：
（1）高能效数字及数模混合存内计算架构
面向人工智能推理与复杂优化计算中数据搬运开销高、存储访问能耗大等问题，研究基于SRAM、eDRAM等存储介质的数字及数模混合存内计算架构，开展存储单元、计算数据流、外围电路和系统架构的协同设计，提升计算芯片的能效、吞吐率与可扩展性。
（2）端侧智能计算与复杂优化硬件加速
面向大模型、具身智能等应用的端侧部署需求，以及科学计算、组合优化与运筹推理等计算密集型任务，研究面向算法特征的专用数据流、可重构计算架构、存储层次和并行求解机制，推动复杂智能与优化任务在资源受限平台上的低时延、高能效执行。
（3）3D-IC设计空间探索与跨层全局优化
面向三维集成芯片和异构集成系统中芯片划分、堆叠方式、互连结构、存储配置的问题，研究面向大规模设计空间的建模、评估与搜索方法，探索人工智能、科学计算、组合优化驱动的自动化设计技术，实现架构、物理实现、功耗、性能和跨层全局优化。
代表性论文及专著

[2] Z. Wu et al., “Advances in ASIC accelerators for combinatorial optimization problems: a hierarchical taxonomy of design methods and hardware trade-offs,” Science China Information Sciences, 2026, doi: 10.1007/s11432-026-5004-y.
[3] Z. Wu et al., “SKADI: A 28nm Complete K-SAT Solver Featuring Bidirectional In-Memory Deduction and Incremental Updating,” IEEE Journal of Solid-State Circuits (JSSC), vol. 61, no. 5, pp. 2295–2308, May 2026.
[4] Z. Wu et al., “SKADI: A 28nm Complete K-SAT Solver Featuring Dual-Path SRAM-Based Macro and Incremental Update with 100% Solvability,” 2025 IEEE International Solid-State Circuits Conference (ISSCC), San Francisco, CA, USA, 2025, pp. 614–616.
[5] Z. Wu et al., “A Variation Tolerant Continuous-Time Ising Machine with eDRAM-based Spin Interaction and Leaked Negative Feedback Annealing,” IEEE Journal of Solid-State Circuits (JSSC), vol. 60, no. 5, pp. 1793–1804, May 2025.

陈铭易
长聘副教授

办公电话：021-34204546
电子邮件：mychen@sjtu.edu.cn

教育背景
【教育背景】
2011.09至2014.06，中国科学院大学，半导体研究所，微电子学与固体电子学，博士（导师：石寅 研究员）
2004.09至2007.03，天津大学，电子信息工程学院，微电子学与固体电子学，硕士
2000.09至2004.06，天津大学，电子信息工程学院，电子科学与技术，学士
工作经历
【个人简介】
陈铭易，欧洲微电子研究中心(IMEC)博士后，现任上海交通大学集成电路学院（信息与电子工程学院）长聘副教授，博士生导师，IEEE高级会员，TCAS-II前任编委。长期从事面向未来产品的高性能模拟与混合信号集成电路设计研究，重点研究领域包括精密传感接口芯片、超高分辨率模数转换器芯片、微能量采集和电源管理芯片等，应用领域涵盖高端装备、脑机接口、人形机器人、精密测量等工业、消费和医疗场景。近三年主持国家自然科学基金面上项目、十四五国家重点研发计划课题、中国电子学会专项，以及企业委托开发等项目十余项。在IEEE JSSC、SSC-L、TIE、TPE、TIM、TBCAS、VLSI Symposium等国际期刊和会议发表论文50余篇，申请发明专利20余项。研究成果获欧盟 “玛丽-居里”卓越奖、华人芯片设计技术研讨会(ICAC)最佳报告奖。承担研究生“双一流”优质课程《高等模拟模拟集成电路设计》获优秀结题。承担本科生《模拟集成电路设计》课程教学，获教学创新大赛二等奖、混合式教学创意设计奖。指导研究生获创“芯”大赛全国一等奖3项，企业杯赛一等奖1项，全国二等奖5项。指导多名研究生获国家奖学金、上海市优秀毕业生、上海交通大学优秀毕业生等奖项。在工业界一线从事芯片设计九年，研发多款用于消费电子和无线通信领域的数模混合信号量产芯片。
【工作经历】
2026.02-至今，上海交通大学集成电路学院（信息与电子工程学院），长聘副教授，博士生导师
2022.05-2026.01，上海交通大学集成电路学院（信息与电子工程学院），长聘教轨副教授，博士生导师

2016.12至2018.12， 欧洲微电子研究中心 (IMEC)，公派博士后（合作导师：Nick Van Helleputte）

2007.03至2009.03，上海泰鼎多媒体科技有限公司，芯片设计工程师
研究方向
长期从事面向未来产品的高性能模拟与混合信号集成电路设计研究，重点研究领域包括：
1. 精密传感接口芯片（脑机接口、人形机器人、精密测量等）

蔡星汉

工作经历
蔡星汉，男，2015年于美国马里兰大学物理系获得博士学位，其后进入华盛顿大学物理系Xiaodong Xu教授课题组担任博士后研究员，于2018年加盟上海交通大学，目前任集成电路学院（信息与电子工程学院）教授，博士生导师，国家高层次青年人才。其长期从事低维量子体系物理性质的研究和后摩尔新型信息器件的设计开发，主持和承担国家自然科学基金委重大研究计划培育项目、面上项目、青年项目、科技部重点研发计划青年科学家项目、上海市科委“基础研究特区计划”项目等，以第一/共一/通讯作者身份多次在Science，Nature Nanotechnology，PNAS，ACS Nano，Nano Letters等权威杂志发表论文，近5年总引用次数超3000次。
研究方向
实验室聚焦于低维量子体系的物理性质研究以及在此基础上的后摩尔新型信息器件设计与开发。围绕低维材料中各类电子态与元激发之间的耦合机制，以及这些量子物态在外场作用下的演化规律这一核心科学问题，采用先进半导体微加工工艺结合界面工程技术，构建低维微纳结构，通过综合运用电输运学、磁学、光电子学和光谱学技术，建立表征和操控介观凝聚态体系中量子物态及新奇现象的有效方法，并构筑高性能原型微纳电子器件。具体研究方向包括：
1. 光-物质相互作用与宽频光探测器件；
2. 二维磁性的操控与自旋电子器件；
3. 新奇物相的演化与新原理量子器件。

研究方向
1．微型仿生机器人
研究适宜在小尺度下工作的仿生扑翼式飞行器（手掌大小及指甲盖大小）、微型爬行机器人、微型游动机器人、微型多栖扑翼飞行机器人（飞爬、飞抓、飞游等）等。包括微型仿生机器人的结构设计、运动动力学仿真分析、驱动器设计及制作、微型机器人零部件加工与整机装配、测控系统软硬件开发（含驱动-传动控制、姿态控制、无线通讯、图传载荷、上位机控制终端等）、性能测试等技术研究。
2．MEMS器件研究
微惯性传感器（微陀螺、微加速度计）、热式微流速传感器、电磁微电机、PCR温控反应芯片等MEMS器件研制，包括MEMS器件的结构仿真设计、微制造工艺与封装、测控电路及集成技术研究。
3. 先进算法与软件开发、基于嵌入式芯片的硬件电路与算法实现
如面向MEMS器件设计应用，开发基于机器学习-智能优化算法的多环谐振微陀螺/谐振器、电磁微电机等微器件的结构参数快速优化设计平台；面向微型仿生机器人视觉手势识别、目标跟踪、自主避障等应用，开展基于传感计算于一体的低功耗集成板载嵌入式（ARM、FPGA、DSP）微系统，实现基于深度学习神经网络算法的板载实时图像智能处理。

daixuhan.officialText:
戴旭涵
副教授

办公电话：021-34206687
电子邮件：xhdai@sjtu.edu.cn

研究方向
1. 低功耗元器件
随着物联网、消费类电子产品的不断演进，降低元器件功耗已成为手机等相关主机产品发展的必然要求，基于微机械切换原理的微继电器、射频开关由于基于欧姆接触实现电路通断，无待机功，与传统的结型半导体器件相比，功耗可下降一个数量级以上。但如何进一步提高切换速度（ns量级），切换寿命（10亿次，则是亟待解决的问题，为此需要从结构设计、材料制备、集成制造方法等多方面探索研究的途径。
2. MEMS微能源（发电机）芯片
无线传感网已成为构建物联网不可或缺的信息感知基础，如何为大量无线传感器节点供电已成为亟待解决的关键技术。传统的电池，电力线供电技术受电池寿命，部署、更换成本高等问题限制，已很难满足要求。相反，利用微机电结构收集周围环境中广泛存在的振动能为物联网节点供能，则有望克服上述问题。但需要解决如何在微尺度下高效收集振动能并转化为电能的问题，为此需要从转换机制、器件设计与集成制造等多方面开展研究。

工作经历
雷冲，上海交通大学，博士，助理研究员。于1999年和2002年在燕山大学材料科学与化学工程学院获得学士和硕士学位。2002年至2004年期间在中科院福建物质结构研究所结构化学国家重点实验室工作。2009年毕业于上海交通大学微纳科学技术研究院并获微电子学与固体电子学博士学位，毕业后留校任教于上海交通大学至今。主要从事MEMS电磁器件和传感器的设计制作、系统集成与工程应用等相关领域研究。
个人入选上海市东方英才计划青年项目（2024年）。近年来主持和参与了国家重点研发计划子课题、国家自然科学基金仪器专项子课题、面上项目、十二五民用航天项目、国家电网总部科技项目、GY专项、上海交大深蓝计划重点项目、上海交大-紫竹概念验证项目、上海市自然科学基金、航天支撑技术基金项目等10余项重要科研项目。

教育背景
姜春蓬，博士，长聘教轨助理教授。2017 年本科毕业于哈尔滨工业大学，2024 年博士毕业于上海交通大学，2024 年 9 月进入上海交通大学信息与通信工程博士后流动站开展研究工作。主要研究方向为 MEMS 脑机接口、人机交互微系统。累积发表学术论文 6 篇，包含 Nature Communications、Science Advances、Advanced Materials、IEEE MEMS 等国际顶尖期刊与会议，部分论文为 ESI 高被引、封面文章，其他合作发表论文10余篇。目前已申请/授权发明专利 7 项。入选 2025 年度博士后创新人才支持计划（博新计划）、上海市 “超级博士后” 激励计划，主持国家自然科学基金青年科学基金（C 类）、中国博士后科学基金面上项目，参与科技创新 2030 重大项目，担任国家重点研发计划子课题负责人，围绕植入式脑机接口和高密度具身触觉感知开展器件研制、系统封装及在体与临床验证相关研究。
工作经历
2024年9月——2026年9月，上海交通大学信息与通信工程流动站，博士后。

MEMS 植入式脑机接口微系统

集成电路先进封装与制造

About us
Si research group was established in 2021, with Department of Electronic Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, China. The research topics of our group include semiconductor fabrication, semiconductor materials and devices, ferroelectric materials, nanoscale devices and technology, etc. Our goal is to explore novel material, device and integration technologies for Post-Moore solutions.

Biography
Chen Zhang is now a Tenure-Track Associate Professor and Ph.D. advisor at the School of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. His research mainly focuses on ML/AI processors and accelerators, especially FPGA and GPU architectures. He received his Ph.D. from Peking University in 2017. From 2015 to 2016, he conducted academic research as a visiting scholar at the University of California, Los Angeles. Before joining SJTU (2017-2023), he worked at Microsoft Research (as a Senior Researcher) and later at Alibaba Cloud (as a Senior Architect), where he led the development of several high-impact AI systems. He has published about 40 papers in top-tier conferences and journals, including ISCA, MICRO, FPGA, DAC, and IEEE TCAD, receiving 5 Best Paper Awards (FPGA’15, TCAD’19, MICRO’22, ISEDA’25, ISCA’25) and 2 Ten-year Retrospective Most Influential Paper Award (FPGA’15, ICCAD’16). His work has been cited over 6,100 times on Google Scholar, with a single paper cited more than 2,900 times. He has been honored as a member of the FPGA and Reconfigurable Computing Hall of Fame, named an AI 2000 Most Influential Scholar in the World, recognized as a Top 2% Most-Cited Researcher by Stanford and Elsevier, and received the WAIC YunFan Award, among other accolades. He is also a recipient of the Shanghai Overseas High-Level Talent Program and Shanghai Qiyuan Young Scientist Program.

教轨助理教授、博士生导师、入选上海市海外高层次人才计划、上海市启源青年学者计划。长期专注于智能处理器架构设计方法研究，包括GPU、FPGA等；在体系结构与EDA领域发表高水平论文约40篇（包括ISCA、MICRO、HPCA、ASPLOS、ICCAD、DAC等）。以第一/通讯作者，获十年回顾最具影响力论文奖2次（FPGA'15、ICCAD'16），最佳论文奖3次（ISCA'25、ISEDA'25、TCAD'19）和最佳论文提名奖2次（FPGA'15、ASPLOS'26）。谷歌施引超过5800次，单篇最高引用超过2800次。担任FPGA名人堂委员会成员、CCF体系结构专业委员会执行委员、CCF集成电路专业委员会执行委员、BAAI青源会成员；担任多个国际国内学术会议主席（GLSVLSI、FPT、ChinaSys等）、期刊青年编委或审稿人（IEEE TRETS、IEEE TECTS、ACM SIGOPS China等）、国际国内会议程序委员会（ISCA、MICRO、DAC、ICCAD等）。多项研究成果被国内国外芯片厂商参考、引用和技术转化。
[2023~Present] 上海交通大学（Shanghai Jiao Tong University）
-- 教轨助理教授（Tenure-track Associate Professor）
[2021~2023] 阿里巴巴（Alibaba Group）
-- 芯片架构师，高级技术专家（Architect）
[2017~2021] 微软亚洲研究院（Microsoft Research Asia）
-- 高级研究员（Senior Researcher）
研究方向
1.多 GPU 超节点与互联系统优化
针对大模型训练与推理过程中日益突出的多卡通信与协同执行瓶颈，研究面向超节点的高效互联架构、通信加速机制与系统软件协同优化方法，重点关注张量并行、MoE 通信、交换机内计算以及通信-计算重叠等关键问题。
代表工作：
【ISCA’2026】MoE-Hub: Taming Software Complexity for Seamless MoE Overlap with Hardware-Accelerated Communication on Multi-GPU Systems
【HPCA’2025】Towards Compute-Aware In-Switch Computing for LLMs Tensor-Parallelism on Multi-GPU Systems
【ISCA’2025】H^2-LLM: Hardware-Dataflow Co-Exploration for Heterogeneous Hybrid-Bonding-based Low-Batch LLM Inference（最佳论文奖）
【Arvix’2024】Infinite-llm: Efficient llm service for long context with distattention and distributed kvcache
2. GPU 架构与稀疏/低比特 AI 计算加速
聚焦现代 GPU 核心计算单元及其数据通路的架构创新，探索高效支持稀疏计算、低比特量化和压缩模型执行的新机制，以提升AI 工作负载在 GPU 平台上的性能与能效。
代表工作：
【ASPLOS’2026】M2XFP: A Metadata-Augmented Microscaling Data Format for Efficient Low-bit Quantization（最佳论文提名）
【ISCA’2021】Dual-side sparse tensor core
【FPGA’2019】Efficient and effective sparse LSTM on FPGA with bank-balanced sparsity
3. 体系结构建模与设计自动化
面向 AI 加速器与新型计算平台的快速设计需求，研究统一的架构抽象、性能建模与自动化设计方法，通过编译、协同探索和设计空间分析工具，加速 AI 加速器从算法到硬件的映射与优化过程。
代表工作：
【ISEDA’2026】DATIS: DRAM Architecture and Technology Integrated Simulation（最佳论文奖）
【T-CAD’2026】Caffeine: Toward uniformed representation and acceleration for deep convolutional neural networks（Donald O. Pederson最佳论文奖）
【FPGA’2015】Optimizing FPGA-based accelerator design for deep convolutional neural networks（十年回顾最具影响力论文奖）

半导体器件与宏微集成实验室（SMIL）面向发展体验与低碳驱动的新型感知、交互与计算系统的产业前沿需求，研究有机与氧化物半导体晶体管与光电器件，以及和异质功能材料、硅基集成电路跨尺度异构集成的关键工艺与设计技术，探索“感/显-存-算”一体集成的新架构与新范式，实现“功能-形态”的可定制化按需设计与制造，突破终端系统的集成形态、能耗与接口带宽的瓶颈。实验室通过课程教学与科研实践，致力于培养专业基础扎实，具有学科交叉思维、科学探索精神与产业逻辑的人才。

教育背景
王隆春，博士，长聘教轨助理教授，博士生导师。2017年本科毕业于电子科技大学，2022年博士毕业于上海交通大学，2025年上海交通大学计算机科学与技术博士后流动站出站，2025年3月加入上海交通大学。主要研究方向为集成电路先进封装与制造、多模态高密度植入式脑机接口器件和微系统以及在体应用。累积发表学术论文20余篇，其中第一作者身份发表9篇，含ACS Nano、Biosensors & Bioelectronics等，担任MedMat特刊客座编辑，并入选Wiley中国高贡献作者奖。近年来，围绕植入式脑机接口器件集成度低和在体分辨率不足的局限性，开展多模态光电集成与千导量级脑机接口研究，并实现在体应用。目前已申请发明专利12项，其中授权8项，参与制定行业标准1项。入选上海市“超级博士后”激励计划，主持国家自然科学基金青年项目、科技创新2030“脑科学与类脑研究”重大专项子课题和中国博士后基金面上等项目。

教育背景
2022年博士毕业于上海交通大学电子信息与电气工程学院，期间赴新加坡南洋理工大学院士团队访学从事硅光子芯片研究。面向集成电路、激光聚变、深海探测等国家重大工程的高精密测量需求，致力于高精度电学与集成硅光MEMS智能传感芯片及微系统的前沿研究。设计研制兼容CMOS-MEMS工艺的高精度传感芯片，结合专用ASIC芯片实现微系统集成，构建可溯源至国际标准的高精度标测平台，突破“感知-读取-测量”关键技术，实现高精度探测及应用。在Applied Physics Letters、Optics Letters、IEEE Journal of Lightwave等领域高水平期刊发表论文20余篇，多项成果发表在OFC、IEEE MEMS、CLEO等国际顶级会议，申请/授权国家发明专利30余项。主持国家自然科学基金青年项目、国家重大专项课题等多项国家级项目。
研究方向

MEMS多元兼容集成制造技术（原非硅微纳集成制造技术及应用）团队，由8位专职教师和4位兼职校外专家组成，拥有微电子、化学、自动化、材料、机械等不同学科背景。团队依托“微米/纳米加工技术国家级重点实验室”和“非硅微纳集成制造上海市专业技术服务平台”，开展以非硅三维微加工为特色的多元兼容集成制造技术研究，并探索其在高性能微纳器件研发领域的创新应用。二十多年来，开发建立了一系列特色微纳加工工艺，并面向智能传感、物联网（IoT）、智慧医疗、重大装备应用等需求，研制了多种不同系列高性能微纳器件：包括微流体器件、微惯性器件、薄膜高温传感器、气敏传感器、植入式软针电极、Optical-MEMS器件、生物传感器、微纳光学器件及金属基微机械零部件等，部分研究成果已获得转化应用。
团队先后主持完成国家级和省部级科研课题数十项，获得发明专利授权100多项，在Advanced Materials、J. MEMS、J. Micromech. Microeng.、Sensors and Actuators和IEEE MEMS等本专业主流期刊和会议上发表学术论文数百篇。先后获得国家技术发明二等奖1次，省部级技术发明一等奖3次，上海市工博会特等奖1次，高交会一等奖1次。

成果展示
MEMS多元兼容集成制造技术（MECMPs）团队，主要研究方向包括多元兼容集成制造技术和高性能微纳器件与系统两个方面。涉及的微加工技术及器件种类繁多，其中开发效果较好的包括超高热流密度微通道散热器、高度集成MEMS惯性开关、高温薄膜传感器、植入式软针电极、双稳态微继电器、RF MEMS器件，气敏传感器、Optical－MEMS器件和微机械部件等。

MEMS多元兼容集成制造技术（原非硅微纳集成制造技术及应用）团队，由8位专职教师和4位兼职校外专家组成，拥有微电子、化学、自动化、材料、机械等不同学科背景。团队依托“微米/纳米加工技术国家级重点实验室”和“非硅微纳集成制造上海市专业技术服务平台”，开展以非硅三维微加工为特色的多元兼容集成制造技术研究，并探索其在高性能微纳器件研发领域的创新应用。二十多年来，开发建立了一系列特色微纳加工工艺，并面向智能传感、物联网（IoT）、智慧医疗、重大装备应用等需求，研制了多种不同系列高性能微纳器件：包括微流体器件、微惯性器件、薄膜高温传感器、气敏传感器、植入式软针电极、Optical-MEMS器件、生物传感器、微纳光学器件及金属基微机械零部件等，部分研究成果已获得转化应用。
团队先后主持完成国家级和省部级科研课题数十项，获得发明专利授权100多项，在Advanced Materials、J. MEMS、J. Micromech. Microeng.、Sensors and Actuators和IEEE MEMS等本专业主流期刊和会议上发表学术论文数百篇。先后获得国家技术发明二等奖1次，省部级技术发明一等奖3次，上海市工博会特等奖1次，高交会一等奖1次。

成果展示
MEMS多元兼容集成制造技术（MECMPs）团队，主要研究方向包括多元兼容集成制造技术和高性能微纳器件与系统两个方面。涉及的微加工技术及器件种类繁多，其中开发效果较好的包括超高热流密度微通道散热器、高度集成MEMS惯性开关、高温薄膜传感器、植入式软针电极、双稳态微继电器、RF MEMS器件，气敏传感器、Optical－MEMS器件和微机械部件等。

长聘教授

教育背景
2025.08~至今，上海交通大学，集成电路学院，长聘教授
2018.12~2025.07，上海交通大学，电子信息与电气工程学院，研究员
2013.12~2018.11，上海交通大学，电子信息与电气工程学院，副研究员
2011.11~2013.11，日本国立产业技术综合研究所（AIST），JSPS博士后特别研究员（JSPS Postdoctoral Fellow）
2010.06~2013.11，上海交通大学，微纳科学技术研究院，助理研究员
2006.04~2010.03，上海交通大学，微纳科学技术研究院，博士
2003.07~2005.09，哈尔滨工程大学，机电工程学院，硕士
1999.09 ~2003.07，哈尔滨工程大学，机电工程学院，本科
工作经历
1982年04月生，上海交通大学集成电路学院长聘教授、博士生导师，“微米纳米加工技术全国重点实验室”骨干成员，于2003年和2005年在哈尔滨工程大学机电工程学院获得学士与硕士学位，2010年获得上海交通大学微电子学与固体电子学博士学位。目前研究工作主要包括先进封装（TSV/TGV）、MEMS惯性开关（近零功耗器件）、PowerMEMS、超细柔性纤维/圆管/毛细管等表面的3D MEMS集成制造技术等。主持承担国家自然科学青年基金、面上项目，国家重点研发计划课题，国家“863”项目子课题，上海市“浦江人才计划”（A类）等项目。
2011-2013年期间，受日本学术振兴会（JSPS）资助赴日本国立产业技术综合研究所（AIST）从事博士后（JSPS Postdoctoral Fellow）工作，研究期间成功开发了可用于超细基底的3D曲面光刻技术，并实现了在微细（~百微米直径）石英圆管、毛细管、以及柔性纤维表面制作高精度、高分辨率的多层多功能微型传感器技术和柔性超细单光纤医用内窥镜探头；同时，结合该研究中心在纳米压印技术上的国际领先优势，完成了能够充分提高信号灵敏度的集成纳米压印的微型MEMS柔性血糖传感器开发，为柔性电子纤维编织提供了重要的技术支撑，获得日本发明专利1项。
近年来，在微机电系统技术（MEMS）领域著名期刊和国际会议IEEE-JMEMS, Adv Mater, Nano Energy, JMM，Lab Chip, IEEE TED, IEEE MEMS, IEEE NEMS, TRANSDUCERS, IEEE ECTC等发表学术论文120多篇，获得授权中国发明专利20余项。多次担任IEEE NANO、IEEE NEMS、APCOT、CSMNT、ICEPT等多个国际会议分会场主席及TPC成员，担任Microsystems & Nanoengineering、IEEE Sensors Journal、Sensors and Actuators A: Physical、Micromachines、《功能材料与器件学报》、《半导体光电》等期刊编委。
目前为IEEE高级会员（IEEE Senior Member）、中国仪器仪表学会微纳器件及系统技术分会常务委员、中国微米纳米技术学会微纳机器人分会理事、中科院深圳先进技术研究院客座研究员、上海市电子学会电子电镀专委会委员、中国微米纳米技术学会（CSMNT）高级会员、上海市传感技术学会理事，2014年入选上海市“浦江人才计划”（A类），2016年获得上海市“技术发明一等奖”，2019年获得工信部科技进步三等奖，2023年获得安徽省科学技术三等奖、上海交通大学“教书育人三等奖”。
研究方向
1.微机电系统（MEMS）：金属基MEMS传感器与执行器
2.MEMS惯性开关器件、物联网近零功耗振动传感器及其相关应用
3.超细基底三维（3D）曲面光刻技术
4.微纳柔性传感技术（超细柔性基传感器、柔性电子器件等）
5.先进封装（TSV、TGV）
科研项目

2.国家自然科学基金面上项目（61571287）： 2016-2019；

研究方向
锂离子电池、钠离子电池、新型碳功能材料、电化学界面过程机制和凝聚态物理学等

开展锂离子电池和钠离子电池相关研究与产业化将近十五年。近十年来一直专注煤基碳材料在电化学储能领域的研究，相关成果发表 SCI 期刊论文 30 余篇，近五年主要成果包括Journal of Materials Chemistry A (通讯作者，IF=10.8)，ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces (第一作者，通讯作者，IF=8.5)，Sustainable Materials and Technologies (第一作者，IF=8.7)，Fuel Processing Technology (第一作者，2 篇，IF=7.2)。累计申请发明专利 14 项，已授权 6 项，申请实用新型专利 1 项，已授权 1 项。

工作经历
朱敏，教授，博导，国家级高层次青年人才。2009年于湖北大学获得学士学位，2014年于中国科学院大学获得博士学位。2014年至2015年在中国科学院上海微系统与信息技术研究所任助理研究员，2015年9月至2017年11月在德国亚琛工业大学作博士后（洪堡学者）。2017年12月回到中国科学院上海微系统与信息技术研究所，历任副研究员、研究员（三级）等职。2025年12月加入上海交通大学集成电路学院，任教授岗位。
从2009年开始从事先进存储器件与芯片研究，在单质新原理开关器件、相变材料“基因”以及开关/存储机理等方面取得了卓有成效的成果。主持了国家自然科学基金优青、面上和青年项目，中国科学院先导B专项子课题、上海市青年科技启明星等多项科研项目。以第一作者或通讯作者在《Science》、《Nature Materials》、《Nature Communications》（5篇）、《Science Advances》（2篇）、《Advanced Materials》（2篇）、《Materials Today》、《Advanced Functional Materials》（3篇）、《Nano-Micro Letters》等国际权威期刊发表SCI论文50余篇。获2022年中国科学十大进展、2025年上海市自然科学一等奖、2020年上海市自然科学一等奖、2022年中国科学院杰出成就奖、中国科学院“百人计划”终期考核优秀、华为奥林帕斯先锋奖、德国洪堡学者及中国科学院院长特别奖等多项荣誉和奖项。

The addition of a magneto electric dipole (ME dipole) antenna to comb structure make the profile height of the proposed ME dipole reduce by 72% to 0.065 lambda compared to the conventional ME dipole antenna, while the proposed antenna maintains the electrical performance advantage of ME dipole, like high gain, high FBRs, low cross-polarization level in the broadside direction and has an impedance bandwidth of 14.65%.
A low-profile frequency-scanning antenna with ground loaded, periodically extending the single ME dipole antenna along the guided wave direction, can scan a wide scanning range, from -63° to 63°, with a high scanning rate of 0.164°/MHz and a low gain fluctuation < 2.5 dB.

分别于1996年、1999年和2003年在西北工业大学获学士、硕士和博士学位。

教学工作
《计算电磁学》
每年春季为硕士生开设课程：计算电磁学 54 学时
计算电磁学是一个多学科领域，其核心学科是电磁理论和数值方法，不过为了有效地实现电磁计算方法和应用，几何模型及其可视化、计算机科学及算法等，都有着非常重要的作用。
这门课主要围绕电磁计算的原理和方法展开，首先阐述电磁问题的场路求解方法的一些观点，然后讲解电磁计算方法的数学基础与泛函解法，第三，讲解电磁场原理与解析方法，包括电磁场的基本原理，同时还会讲述经典的解析方法求解电磁场问题，及等效原理和分离变量法；第四讲述算法综述，主要讲述各类数值解法的发展过程，以及电磁计算方法的归类；第五，讲述矩量法的基本原理和应用；第六，讲述时域有限差分法的基本原理与应用；第七，针对电大尺寸问题讲述几何绕射理论；第八，讲述并行计算；第九，就目前的最新发展讲述计算电磁学的发展趋势。
课程讲述过程中，会同步布置相应的大作业，并请同学们在讲课间隙中汇报大作业。
《现代天线高级论题与创新研究方法》
研讨型课程，2021年秋季开始面向硕士生、博士生开课，32学时
随着电子信息技术和材料物理领域的飞速发展，天线技术也日新月异，很多新理论、新材料和技术也被引入天线研究设计，尤其是近几年，新概念天线、新材料天线、新机理天线、新技术天线等推陈出新，使天线发展和研究进入新的高潮，很多新天线不仅原理新颖，功能强大，甚至对传输系统产生了革命性的推动力。
另一方面，在指导硕士和博士论文研究过程中，发现很多学生不知道如何开展科研工作，对本学科研究前沿进展不敏感，包括发现问题、分析问题和解决问题的方法思路欠缺。
本课程主要面向本学科的博士生和学位硕士生，通过教学和研讨，引导学生关注本学科的最新研究前沿的一些问题，让学生学会从需求或思考来独立发现问题、分析问题和解决问题等开展科研工作的方法。
这门课主要围绕现代天线技术最新发展和天线的创新研究方法展开，首先阐述现代天线的最新发展趋势和一些观点。其次，讲解创新研究的一般思路，对创新研究的偶然性、必然性进行系统解剖。第三，讲述电磁界面理论和超材料天线及液晶天线等应用的最新发展，并引导学生围绕该主题进行创新探索。第四，讲述THz和纳米材料特性与天线结合的最新发展动态，并引导学生围绕该主题进行创新探索。第五，讲述SSPPs理论和天线结合的最新发展动态，并引导学生围绕该主题进行创新探索。第六，讲述微型化天线理论和非谐振式天线的最新发展动态，并引导学生围绕该主题进行创新探索。第七，讲述OAM理论和天线的最新发展动态，并引导学生围绕该主题进行创新探索。第八，讲述相模天线和广义阵列的理论和最新发展动态，并引导学生围绕该主题进行创新探索。第九，结合应用需求和交叉学科的最新发展，引导学生进行未来天线理论和技术的创新探索研究。
课程讲述过程中，会同步布置相应的大作业，并请同学们围绕相关主题进行创新探索。
先修课程：电磁场理论，微波技术，天线理论和技术。

Xiaoyun Zhang, Professor of Cooperative Medianet Innovation Center (CMIC), Shanghai Jiao Tong University. She received her Ph.D (supervised by Yuncai Liu) on Pattern Recognition from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Master (supervised by Zongben Xu) on Applied Mathematics from Xi`an Jiao Tong University respectively. She has co-authorized papers on IEEE TPAMI, TIP, CVPR, ICCV, etc., and her Ph.D. thesis has been nominated as “National 100 Best Ph.D. Theses of China”. She has been a visiting scholar of Harvard University for one year. She is also a member of State Key Laboratory of UHD video and audio production and presentation, and has collaboration with CCTV in video restoration and enhancement.
MediaBrain group of CMIC currently has 7 professors including from Oxford, Cambridge, CMU, focusing on multimedia and medical area. Our group provides compute resource with over hundreds of GPUs, and experienced writing guide for top level research papers. Currently, our group has over 80 master and Ph.d students with good academic atmosphere and rich activities, including cutting-edge seminars for academic, and birthday celebration for fun.

Qiang Hu
Assistant Researcher
Shanghai Jiao Tong University
I am currently an Associate Professor at the Cooperative Medianet Innovation Center (CMIC),
Shanghai Jiao Tong University, working with Prof. Wenjun Zhang .
I received my B.Eng. degree in Electronic Information Engineering from
the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China in 2013
and my Ph.D. degree in Information and Communication Engineering from
Shanghai Jiao Tong University in 2019.
From 2019 to 2021, I was a Postdoctoral Researcher supervised by
Prof. Jingyi Yu
at ShanghaiTech University, and I was selected for the Shanghai “Super Postdoctoral” Incentive Program. My research interests focus on
2D/3D video compression and processing, 3D reconstruction and generation, and visual quality assessment.
Looking for self-motivated students (PhD, Master and Undergraduate RA) working with me. For prospective students, please send your resume and transcript to my email.

Projects
Real-Time Interactive Free-Viewpoint Video Streaming
We have developed an integrated solution that delivers live and on-demand FVV streaming services in real-time. Our solution provides an immersive and interactive viewing experience for FVV content, even on lightweight devices via mobile networks. Furthermore, our system is optimized to support UHD FVV applications on such devices, offering users an unparalleled viewing experience.
Online Experience
Video
Distribute the Power of Radiance Rendering via the Cloud
We adopt a streaming-based solution where computationally intensive workloads are conducted on cloud servers, and their results are sent to the client as a video stream. It enables an immersive and interactive viewing experience for the neural radiance field on lightweight devices (e.g., cell phones, VR headsets).
Online Experience

Projects
Real-Time Interactive Free-Viewpoint Video Streaming
We have developed an integrated solution that delivers live and on-demand FVV streaming services in real-time. Our solution provides an immersive and interactive viewing experience for FVV content, even on lightweight devices via mobile networks. Furthermore, our system is optimized to support UHD FVV applications on such devices, offering users an unparalleled viewing experience.
Online Experience
Video
Distribute the Power of Radiance Rendering via the Cloud
We adopt a streaming-based solution where computationally intensive workloads are conducted on cloud servers, and their results are sent to the client as a video stream. It enables an immersive and interactive viewing experience for the neural radiance field on lightweight devices (e.g., cell phones, VR headsets).

huqiang.officialText:
胡强
副研究员
所在系所：未来媒体网络协同创新中心
电子邮件：qiang.hu@sjtu.edu.cn
通讯地址：上海市闵行区东川路800号电院5号楼303A
个人主页：https://qianghu-huber.github.io/qianghuhomepage/
工作经历
胡强，上海交通大学副教授。2013 年获电子科技大学电子信息工程学士学位，2019 年获上海交通大学信息与通信工程博士学位，2019–2021 年在上海科技大学虞晶怡教授团队从事博士后研究，并入选上海市“超级博士后”激励计划。其研究方向为生成式智能媒体与 Agentic AI，重点围绕空间智能三维重建与生成、2D/3D 视频编码与增强以及视觉内容质量评价开展研究。相关成果发表于 IEEE TPAMI、JSAC、TIP、TCSVT、TMM、CVPR、ICCV、NeurIPS、ICML 等国际顶级期刊与会议，累计发表论文 60 余篇；已申请发明专利 50 余项，其中 20 余项获得授权，1 项国际发明专利已完成成果技术转移。主持国家自然科学基金面上项目、上海市自然科学基金面上项目、上海市科技创新行动计划及国家重点实验室开放基金等科研项目，相关研究成果已在中央广播电视总台、哔哩哔哩、中国商飞上海飞机制造有限公司、中国国际进口博览会智能安检系统，以及西安全运会和冬奥会赛事转播等实际场景中应用。现任 APSIPA Transactions on Signal and Information Processing 编委、Future Internet 客座编委、AIGC 青年大学生就业创业促进行动评审专家，组织 CVPR NTIRE 2025 XGC、 CVPR NTIRE 2026 X-AIGC等质量评价挑战赛，并长期服务于 JSAC、IJCV、TVCG、TCSVT、TMM、CVPR、NeurIPS、ICCV、AAAI 等期刊与会议审稿工作。曾获上海市科技进步一等奖、IEEE VCIP 2025 最佳论文奖、广播电视和网络视听人工智能应用创新大赛智能修复与增强一等奖、IEEE JSTSP 封面论文、CVPR 2025 杰出审稿人、IEEE ICIP Top 5% Award 及《广播电视网络》2024 年优秀论文奖，并在SIGGRAPH Asia、CVPR等国际挑战赛中多次荣获冠亚军。
研究方向
1. 生成式智能媒体与Agentic AI
2. 2D/3D视频编码、增强与质量评价
3. 空间智能三维重建与生成
科研项目
1. 国家自然科学基金委员会, 面上, 基于3D 高斯泼溅的体积视频编码关键技术研究， 2026.1至 2029.12, 主持
2. 上海市科学技术委员会, 科技创新行动计划, 多模态三维重建数据采集系统， 2024.12至 2025.11, 结题，主持
3. 上海市科学技术委员会, 自然科学基金面上项目, 面向沉浸式3D呈现的体积视频高效编解码方法研究， 2024.10至 2027.09, 主持
4. 中央广播电视总台，超高清视音频制播呈现国重实验室开放基金，8K 3D视频增强制作及显示关键技术研究及应用，2023.11-2024.11，结题，主持
5. 上海市人力资源和社会保障局, 创新人才计划, 上海市“超级博士后”激励计划, 2020.01至 2021.07, 结题, 主持
6. 上海哔哩哔哩科技有限公司, 校企合作项目，视频画质修复增强与视频质量评价数据集建设, 2024.03至 2026.02, 主持
7. 上海飞机制造有限公司, 校企合作项目，视觉管控服务平台软硬件加速算法研究, 2023.07至 2024.06, 主持

Profile
Bin XIA obtained his BS and MS degree from the University of Science Technology of China (USTC), Hefei, China in 1997 and 2000, respectively,
both in Communication Information Engineering. He received his Ph.D degree in Communication Engineering from Hong Kong University (HKU) in 2004.
From 1999 to 2001, he was involved in the algorithm research and system development for the first IS-95 based CDMA system in China and the first commercial WCDMA UE Emulator in the world as Research Assistant in USTC, and Department Manager in the Joint Wireless Soft. Research LAB of USTC and UTStarcom Inc.
In 2004, he was Research Fellow in Wireless Communication LAB of HKU.
From 2004 to 2005, he was with the Mobile Communication Group, Alcatel Co., Ltd., where he was serving as Senior System Engineer for the first commercial
WiMAX system in the world.
From 2005 to 2012, he was serving as Senior Research Engineer, Project Manager of Key Technology Research Development for the Long Term Evolution
(LTE) Advanced systems, and the first Project Manager of R&D for the TDD-LTE prototype, in the Wireless Research Department, Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.
He was the found chair of digital industry convergence working group of Wireless World Research Forum (WWRF).He is a senior member of IEEE,
and has served as a TPC member for many conferences. He has served as publicity chair of IEEE WCNC2013, general co-chair of Workshop on Internet of
Things of IEEE ICCC2014, workshop co-chair of IEEE ICC2015, and executive co-chair of IEEE ICC2019.
He received the 2019 IEEE ComSoc Asia-Pacific Outstanding Paper Award, and 2020 the first prize in Shanghai's Nature Science Award.

成果介绍
高速互连技术- 高速数据传输的关键技术
提出了太比特量级毫米波互连技术
难点：
传统互连技术带宽窄、损耗高、串扰严重，无法满足太比特高速数据传输需求。
创新点：
1. 提出了基于多目标优化的片上互连设计方法； 提出了新型毫米波互连技术，实现了太比特数据传输
2. 发表在微波领域国际顶级刊物 IEEE Trans. MTT 2017、电子器件领域国际顶级刊物 IEEE Trans. ED 2015；在华为公司
的高速数据传输链路中应用。
实现了片上纳米互连的多目标优化技术
创新点：
1. 提出了综合考虑时延、功耗和带宽的互连优化设计原理与方法，得到了45-130纳米工艺全局互连最优设计参数，在成本
不增加的前提下使互连综合性能提高30%以上。
2. Mentor Graphics公司采用该技术设计实现了多种片上网络芯片：蝶形互连和异构单元通信互连。
大规模集成电路EDA技术
创新点：
1. 提出了纳米互连的精确时延、功耗模型
2. 自主开发了大规模集成电路的布局布线与仿真软件
3. 应用于世界最大EDA软件公司CADENCE的仿真软件，解决了互连的非线性信号响应分析难题。
电磁兼容技术- 高速电子系统的关键技术
创新点：
1. 提出了基于精确传输线模型的信号响应分析方法
2. 提出了具有多尺度的电源完整性分析方法
3. 提出了电磁兼容性测量、诊断一体化系统解决方案

课题组博士生武泽明获PIERS 2025最佳学生论文奖
新闻链接：https://news.sjtu.edu.cn/jdyw/20250515/210528.html
5月4日至8日，第46届光子与电磁学研究国际研讨会(Photonics & Electromagnetics Research Symposium, PIERS)在阿联酋阿布扎比召开，本次会议分为5个主题，共收到1463篇投稿，每个主题共颁发最佳学生论文奖三个。集成电路学院(信息与电子工程学院)射频异质异构集成全国重点实验室李晓春教授课题组投稿的论文“针对微波无源器件的半监督可逆神经网络逆建模技术”(An Inverse Modelling Technique Based on Semi-supervised Invertible Neural Network for Microwave Components)荣获最佳学生论文奖 (BEST STUDENT PAPER AWARD)。该论文作者为：武泽明（2020级直博生），李正（2019级直博生），陈海标（2023级博士研究生），李晓春（集成电路学院(信息与电子工程学院)教授，指导导师），毛军发（中国科学院院士，IEEE Fellow）。
PIERS是电磁科学院（The Electromagnetics Academy）主办的介绍与促进光子与电磁学进展的大型系列性国际性学术会议，自1989年以来，每年度都在世界各地主要城市例如Cambridge，Seattle，Innsbruck，Tokyo，Prague，Marrakesh，Stockholm，Singapore，Rome，Shanghai等巡回举办，2013年以来每年规模都在千人以上，是电磁学领域最具有影响力的系列性国际学术会议之一。
研究背景
微波无源器件的逆建模设计可以通过机器学习模型实现，逆建模将设计目标作为输入，直接得到设计的尺寸参数，极大降低了设计门槛，缩短了设计时间。然而目前存在的逆建模方法会遇到非唯一解导致的低精度问题与数据集需求过大导致的数据获取低效率问题，限制了逆建模方法在微波无源器件设计的应用。
论文介绍
针对上述问题，本工作提出了半监督-可逆神经网络逆建模方法，该方法共包含两个模块： 半监督学习生成数据集模块与设计参数生成与选择模块。半监督学习中，通过使用少量数据集训练正向模型多层感知机与高斯过程，并利用它们扩展数据集，使用扩展的数据集训练生成式的可逆神经网络。在设计参数生成与选择中，使用训练好的可逆神经网络生成多组设计候选值，并利用正向模型来选择出符合设计目标的设计参数。基于该设计方法，我们设计了HMSIW-SSPP的单元结构，设计目标为HMSIW-SSPP的通带的下截止频率和上截止频率，设计参数为单元结构的6个尺寸参数。设计结果表明，所提出的半监督-可逆神经网络逆建模方法同其他逆建模方法如多层感知机、多值神经网络相比，提升了设计精度，同使用可逆神经网络相比，提高了数据集获取效率。

李晓春，博士，上海交通大学电子信息与电气工程学院、教育部高速电子系统设计与电磁兼容研究重点实验室教授，博士生导师，国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金获得者,上海交通大学晨星学者。
长期从事高速与微波电路、互连技术、电磁兼容等研究工作，发表论文100余篇。主持/参与国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金、国家自然科学基金青年科学基金、国家自然科学基金创新研究群体科学基金、973项目、863项目、三星项目、华为项目等。
博士学位论文“高速集成电路中互连线信号响应与功耗的分析优化”获2011年全国优秀博士学位论文提名奖、以及上海市研究生优秀成果奖。科研项目“电源完整性研究”获2014年“国际大川情报通信基金研究奖”；科研项目“小型化高性能微波无源元件与天线”获2008年国家技术发明二等奖；科研项目“新型微波射频电路研究”获2005年上海市科技进步一等奖。2010年获得上海交通大学SMC-晨星青年学者称号。2016获上海交通大学烛光奖励计划二等奖。2011年获得电子信息与电气工程学院“优秀共产党员”称号。 2016年获上海交通大学优秀党务工作者。
担任中国电子学会青年科学家俱乐部成员、微波与电路系统专委会委员，IEEE EDAPS国际电子器件封装会议TPC成员，International Conference on ASIC proceedings分会主席,《上海交通大学学报》英文版客座编辑。常年担任IEEE Trans. Electron Devices、IEEE Trans. Computational Science & Electromagnetic Engineering Group
Jiaqing Lu, Associate Professor, Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
School of Information Science and Electronic Engineering
SJTU, Shanghai, China
Our research focuses on Computational Electromagnetics and Scientific Computing.
Our research areas include:
Computational Methods: finite element methods, domain decomposition methods, high-performance direct & iterative algorithms.
Large-Scale Simulation: antenna arrays, UAVs, automobiles, mobile devices, complex EMC/EMI applications.
Multiscale & Multiphysics Modeling: electromagnetic and coupled-physics modeling of integrated electronic systems (PCBs & packages & ICs), signal/power integrity problems.
about me
I received my B.S. and M.S. degrees from Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), and my Ph.D. degree from The Ohio State University (OSU). During my Ph.D., I conducted my research at the ElectroScience Laboratory (ESL), OSU, under the supervision of Prof. Jin-Fa Lee, one of the most influential authorities in computational electromagnetics and the key contributor to Ansys HFSS.
After my graduation, I continued my research at ESL as a postdoctoral researcher. I later returned to China and worked as an algorithm engineer at NineCube Microelectronics, developing simulation software for electronic design automation (EDA). In 2026, I returned to SJTU and became a faculty member.

selected publications
IEEE TAP
An Embedded Domain Decomposition Method for Electromagnetic Modeling and Design
Jiaqing Lu, Yongpin Chen, Dongwei Li, and Jin-Fa Lee
IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation, Jan 2019
Abs HTML
Domain Decomposition
An embedded domain decomposition method (DDM) is presented herein for solving electromagnetic problems with complex geometries. In the method, the original computational domain is decomposed into a background subdomain and multiple embedded subdomains. The subdomain problems are easier to solve than the original problem. Furthermore, the shape of the subdomains can be geometrically non-conformal, and the discretizations in the subdomains are allowed to be completely independent. Information exchange between the background and embedded subdomains are addressed in their shared regions, including four ingredients: field continuity, material difference, perfect electrical conductor (PEC), and port. Field continuity on the boundaries of the embedded subdomains is weakly enforced by employing Robin transmission condition. Modified volume sources are introduced to account for material difference between the subdomains. For PEC and port, surface currents on them in embedded subdomains are impressed into the background subdomain in a proper way. The accuracy and flexibility of the proposed method are demonstrated through several numerical examples.
IEEE TMTT
Convergence Enhancement for Embedded Domain Decomposition Method Through Spectral Radius Reduction
Jiaqing Lu
IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques, Oct 2024
Abs HTML
Domain Decomposition Preconditioning IC & EDA Antenna & Material Data-Driven Methods
The embedded domain decomposition method (DDM) has emerged as an innovative DDM variant for electromagnetic simulations, offering enhanced flexibility in geometrical modeling and mesh generation. While previous studies have shown rapid convergence for this method, our recent applications have uncovered certain convergence challenges. Targeting these convergence issues, this work introduces a preconditioner by constructing an approximate inverse to the system matrix of embedded DDM. The preconditioner is built upon two major ingredients: randomized sampling and spectral radius reduction. Through randomized sampling of system equations, we efficiently extract essential information from the DDM matrix without the need for explicit entry evaluations. These samples are then progressively compressed in an adaptive manner combined with spectral radius estimations. Numerical experiments demonstrate the impact of spectral radius on system convergence and the effectiveness of numerical compression in optimizing system eigenspectrum. Subsequent validation through numerical examples showcases the preconditioner’s capability in ensuring robust convergence and improving stability of embedded DDM.
JCP
A compression scheme for domain decomposition method in solving electromagnetic problems
Jiaqing Lu and Jin-Fa Lee
Journal of Computational Physics, Apr 2024
Abs HTML
Direct Solver Antenna & Material
A compression framework is presented for improving the domain decomposition method (DDM) in solving Maxwell’s equations. Because the DDM heavily relies on the numerical computation at the subdomain interfaces, the proposed approach focuses on effectively generating the boundary and port solutions of the subdomains. In each subdomain, the original building block is decomposed into a number of subblocks by the nested dissection method. The boundary matrices of the subblocks are compressed as hierarchical matrices and merged into larger ones with respect to the partition tree. Combining with the finite element tearing and interconnecting technique, the original DDM system can be transformed into an interface relation enabling fast matrix operations. Moreover, the memory consumption of DDM is also reduced as only the interface unknowns are kept in the solution process. The accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method are studied and compared with direct DDM method through several numerical examples.
IEEE TAP
A Low-Rank Direct Solver for Nonconformal Domain Decomposition Methods
Jiaqing Lu
IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation, Aug 2024
Abs HTML
Direct Solver Domain Decomposition Antenna & Material IC & EDA
Nonoverlapping and nonconformal domain decomposition methods (DDMs) have established an effective discretization framework for complex electromagnetic applications, where global iterative solvers are commonly employed to tackle DDM equations. However, DDMs are not free from convergence issues, and excessive iteration numbers can significantly prolong the duration of simulations involving multiple right-hand sides. This study explores the possibility in developing a low-rank direct solver for nonconformal DDMs, with the goal of offering a stable and reliable alternative to DDM iterative approaches. Our direct solver consists of two major components: a subdomain solver and a DDM solver. The subdomain solver is developed by extracting an interface skeleton from subdomains, achieved through recursive partitioning and merging of mesh elements. The DDM solver builds upon the skeletonization, and is constructed through recursive reorderings of interface matrices with the integration of hierarchical matrix techniques and randomized matrix compressions. Both solvers have drawn inspirations from existing mathematical studies but also possess distinct features due to unique matrix structures in DDMs. We validate and demonstrate the effectiveness of our solver through several numerical examples, showcasing its capability to stably handle DDM systems and its efficiency in scenarios involving multiple right-hand sides.
IEEE TEMC
Vulnerability Assessment of Integrated Circuits Through Electromagnetic-Circuit Cosimulation
Jiaqing Lu, Yagmur Ozturk, Wentao Bao, Jingyue Zhang, Shane Smith, Kubilay Sertel, and Jin-Fa Lee
IEEE Transactions on Electromagnetic Compatibility, Oct 2024
Abs HTML
EMC & Security IC & EDA Multiphysics Domain Decomposition
An electromagnetic (EM)-circuit cosimulation approach is presented for evaluating the vulnerability of integrated circuits (ICs) when exposed to external EM waves. The approach comprises frequency-domain simulations of an EM subsystem, time-domain simulations of a circuit subsystem, and an interface scheme that integrates the two subsystems. To address the multiscale geometric complexities in intricate circuit designs, a nonconformal domain decomposition method is employed for efficient mesh generation and numerical computations. For capturing the EM subsystem’s behavior over a wide-frequency band, an adaptive interpolation scheme, built upon Loewner matrix technique, is developed for fast frequency sweep. The simulated and interpolated behavior of the EM subsystem is integrated with IC models and subsequently processed with time-domain analyzes. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the method and assess the EM vulnerability of a practical IC design, numerical simulations and laboratory experiments are conducted utilizing near-field antenna and far-field wave sources.

Electromagnetic emission simulation of radio frequency circuits using direct domain decomposition solver
Jiaqing Lu
IEEE Microwave and Wireless Technology Letters, Jun 2025
Abs HTML
IC & EDA EMC & Security Direct Solver Domain Decomposition
The increasing integration complexity and operating frequency of modern circuit designs necessitate comprehensive electromagnetic (EM) simulations for accurate performance assessment. Addressing this need, this letter presents a direct domain decomposition solver for radio frequency (RF) circuits. It incorporates nonconformal discretizations to manage multiscale geometries alongside a systematic integration of higher order absorbing boundary condition (ABC), multilevel skeletonization, and hierarchical matrix factorization. Diverse numerical techniques are developed to ensure truncation accuracy, solution stability, and computation efficiency. The proposed simulation techniques are applied for analyzing EM emissions of real-life circuits, with results validated through measurements.

The embedded domain decomposition method (DDM) has emerged as an innovative DDM variant for electromagnetic simulations, offering enhanced flexibility in geometrical modeling and mesh generation. While previous studies have shown rapid convergence for this method, our recent applications have uncovered certain convergence challenges. Targeting these convergence issues, this work introduces a preconditioner by constructing an approximate inverse to the system matrix of embedded DDM. The preconditioner is built upon two major ingredients: randomized sampling and spectral radius reduction. Through randomized sampling of system equations, we efficiently extract essential information from the DDM matrix without the need for explicit entry evaluations. These samples are then progressively compressed in an adaptive manner combined with spectral radius estimations. Numerical experiments demonstrate the impact of spectral radius on system convergence and the effectiveness of numerical compression in optimizing system eigenspectrum. Subsequent validation through numerical examples showcases the preconditioner’s capability in ensuring robust convergence and improving stability of embedded DDM.

A compression framework is presented for improving the domain decomposition method (DDM) in solving Maxwell’s equations. Because the DDM heavily relies on the numerical computation at the subdomain interfaces, the proposed approach focuses on effectively generating the boundary and port solutions of the subdomains. In each subdomain, the original building block is decomposed into a number of subblocks by the nested dissection method. The boundary matrices of the subblocks are compressed as hierarchical matrices and merged into larger ones with respect to the partition tree. Combining with the finite element tearing and interconnecting technique, the original DDM system can be transformed into an interface relation enabling fast matrix operations. Moreover, the memory consumption of DDM is also reduced as only the interface unknowns are kept in the solution process. The accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method are studied and compared with direct DDM method through several numerical examples.

Nonoverlapping and nonconformal domain decomposition methods (DDMs) have established an effective discretization framework for complex electromagnetic applications, where global iterative solvers are commonly employed to tackle DDM equations. However, DDMs are not free from convergence issues, and excessive iteration numbers can significantly prolong the duration of simulations involving multiple right-hand sides. This study explores the possibility in developing a low-rank direct solver for nonconformal DDMs, with the goal of offering a stable and reliable alternative to DDM iterative approaches. Our direct solver consists of two major components: a subdomain solver and a DDM solver. The subdomain solver is developed by extracting an interface skeleton from subdomains, achieved through recursive partitioning and merging of mesh elements. The DDM solver builds upon the skeletonization, and is constructed through recursive reorderings of interface matrices with the integration of hierarchical matrix techniques and randomized matrix compressions. Both solvers have drawn inspirations from existing mathematical studies but also possess distinct features due to unique matrix structures in DDMs. We validate and demonstrate the effectiveness of our solver through several numerical examples, showcasing its capability to stably handle DDM systems and its efficiency in scenarios involving multiple right-hand sides.

Domain decomposition methods (DDMs) provide a powerful discretization framework for analyzing the electromagnetic (EM) phenomena in complex high-speed circuits. However, even with recent advancements in DDMs, achieving iterative convergence remains challenging for sophisticated structures. To facilitate the convergence of DDMs, we develop a preconditioner in this work, which is constructed by forming the approximate inverse of the DDM system matrix. The subdomains are recursively grouped into a multilevel tree, and randomized matrix compressions are adapted to handle their couplings. The approximate inverse preconditioner is then constituted by the inverses of the subdomain matrices with low-rank updates that account for their couplings. Through simulations of practical circuit examples, the strengths of the preconditioner are demonstrated by comparing it to a standard DDM solver. Importantly, a weakly convergent scenario is identified for DDMs when circuit signals propagate parallel to the subdomain interfaces. This situation, which significantly hinders computational efficiency and causes stability issues, can be effectively addressed through the proposed preconditioning approach. Finally, a novel integration is introduced to combine our method with a recently developed subdomain compression scheme.

In finite element simulations, absorbing boundary conditions (ABCs) are recognized as simple but useful techniques for domain truncations. However, the widely employed first-order ABC often encounters accuracy challenges, and existing second-order ABCs are also limited in their handling of domain corners. This study proposes a novel ABC formulation, distinguished by its improved accuracy and versatility. It is developed by projecting field normal components onto auxiliary variables and implemented without the necessity of a smooth domain boundary. Numerical examples showcase the accuracy enhancement achieved with the proposed ABC over traditional ABCs and the applicability of the new ABC implementation for finite element domains with nonsmooth boundaries.

The phenomenon of electromagnetic (EM) emission from printed circuit boards (PCBs) is demonstrated through numerical simulations as well as laboratory-scale measurements. On the simulation side, a systematic workflow is presented for translating conventional circuit designs into numerical models, where the analysis is carried out by employing the nonconformal domain decomposition method (DDM). To improve the efficiency of numerical computation, an interface skeleton is developed by compressing the subdomain information to the touching interfaces and discarding the noncritical field variables recursively. The experimental characterization of EM field emissions in this work employs a vector network analyzer (VNA), a magnetic field probe, and computer-controlled positioners. Through simulation and measurement, several experiments have been conducted to validate the proposed approach to model stray radiation from circuit boards in the form of near-field radiation patterns. Furthermore, the impact of the probe geometry on capturing the emitted fields and the hot spots in electronic radiation are presented.

An electromagnetic (EM)-circuit cosimulation approach is presented for evaluating the vulnerability of integrated circuits (ICs) when exposed to external EM waves. The approach comprises frequency-domain simulations of an EM subsystem, time-domain simulations of a circuit subsystem, and an interface scheme that integrates the two subsystems. To address the multiscale geometric complexities in intricate circuit designs, a nonconformal domain decomposition method is employed for efficient mesh generation and numerical computations. For capturing the EM subsystem’s behavior over a wide-frequency band, an adaptive interpolation scheme, built upon Loewner matrix technique, is developed for fast frequency sweep. The simulated and interpolated behavior of the EM subsystem is integrated with IC models and subsequently processed with time-domain analyzes. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the method and assess the EM vulnerability of a practical IC design, numerical simulations and laboratory experiments are conducted utilizing near-field antenna and far-field wave sources.

In complex electromagnetic simulations, domain decomposition method (DDM) has been shown to be an effective approach for discretization. However, convergence difficulty exists due to the redundant cement variables defined on the corner edges of the subdomains. In this work, we propose a solution to this issue by employing the method of Lagrange multiplier. By incorporating constraints for the corner fields and expanding the system matrix, the condition number of the DDM matrix is reduced significantly. As a result, the convergence rate of the DDM iterations is remarkably improved.

An embedded domain decomposition method (DDM) is presented herein for solving electromagnetic problems with complex geometries. In the method, the original computational domain is decomposed into a background subdomain and multiple embedded subdomains. The subdomain problems are easier to solve than the original problem. Furthermore, the shape of the subdomains can be geometrically non-conformal, and the discretizations in the subdomains are allowed to be completely independent. Information exchange between the background and embedded subdomains are addressed in their shared regions, including four ingredients: field continuity, material difference, perfect electrical conductor (PEC), and port. Field continuity on the boundaries of the embedded subdomains is weakly enforced by employing Robin transmission condition. Modified volume sources are introduced to account for material difference between the subdomains. For PEC and port, surface currents on them in embedded subdomains are impressed into the background subdomain in a proper way. The accuracy and flexibility of the proposed method are demonstrated through several numerical examples.

In integrated circuit designs, adjustments and replacements of components are frequently required for analyzing or improving signal integrity. However, the modifications of geometry will cause remeshings and resimulations in the full-wave analysis. Consequently, the design efficiency can be impaired due to repeated discretizations. In this paper, we introduce an embedded domain decomposition approach to address such repetitive simulations. A problem is first decomposed into a simpler background subdomain and multiple embedded subdomains. The geometrical details of interest can be placed into the embedded subdomains while the background subdomain covers the rest. Afterward, the communications between the subdomains are built by imposing coupling sources that represent field continuities, material polarizations, and surface currents on perfect electric conductor and port. The meshes between the subdomains are completely nonconformal, and the modification of an embedded subdomain will not affect the geometries and discretizations in the other subdomains. Such flexibility can be exploited in simulating complicated 3-D printed circuit board structures or investigating different components in an electronic system, as illustrated in the numerical examples.

Min Tang, Jiaqing Lu, Junfa Mao, and Lijun Jiang

Abs HTML
EMC & Security IC & EDA
This paper presents a systematic electromagnetic-circuit method for efficient simulation of coupled interconnects on dispersive dielectrics in the presence of electromagnetic interference. The dispersive substrate of coupled interconnects is characterized by the multiterm Debye or Lorentz formula. According to the differential equations derived from the equivalent circuit modeling of dispersive media, the full-wave finite-difference time-domain algorithm is utilized to capture accurate field in a dispersive substrate. The effects of incident field, under the quasi-TEM assumption, are then represented by the distributed sources along transmission lines. An efficient algorithm based on the waveform relaxation with transverse partitioning (WR-TP) is employed for fast simulation of coupled transmission lines. A simple and clear derivation of the relaxation sources in WR-TP is described and the compact results are given. The impact of dispersive dielectrics on the incident field, and thus to the transient response of interconnects, is investigated by comparison with conventional techniques. Several numerical examples are given to illustrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

工作经历
国家级、上海市级青年人才，博士生导师。主要从事计算电磁学与科学计算研究，研究方向包括有限元分析、区域分解方法、多尺度电磁建模、大规模电磁问题快速求解以及电磁场-电路-热场联合仿真等，面向复杂电子系统、天线阵列、集成电路与封装等应用中的大规模、多尺度电磁建模与计算问题。发表学术论文 30 余篇，包括 IEEE TMTT、IEEE TAP、JCP 等国际权威期刊。主持国家自然科学基金面上项目、全国重点实验室开放课题等，获电磁学研究进展国际研讨会（PIERS）青年科学家奖、IEEE 电磁兼容年会最佳论文荣誉奖等奖项。
师从计算电磁学权威、第一版电磁仿真软件 HFSS 的核心开发者 Jin-Fa Lee 教授。博士及博士后期间在美国俄亥俄州立大学从事计算电磁学研究，与 Ansys 公司、CYAN 研究中心、Sandia 国家实验室、新加坡 DSO 等机构开展长期研究合作，参与多个大规模电磁仿真与科学计算相关研究项目。回国后曾于九同方微电子公司从事算法与 EDA 软件开发，2026 年加入上海交通大学。
研究方向
1. 计算电磁学与高性能数值算法
研究基于数学物理方程的高性能数值方法，包括有限元分析、区域分解方法、直接求解器、分层低秩压缩算法等，面向大规模科学计算与实际工程问题。
2. 多尺度电磁与多物理场系统仿真
面向芯片、三维封装、PCB、天线阵列及无人系统等复杂电子环境，研究跨尺度电磁与多物理场建模与仿真方法。
3. 射频集成电路与EDA
研究集成电路、封装与电子系统中信号完整性、电源完整性、电磁兼容等问题的大规模建模与高效分析方法。
4. 机器学习与科学计算结合
探索机器学习与传统科学计算方法结合的新型仿真框架。
